name: mmorpg-content-agents
description: Clean-architecture multi-agent content pipeline (Story, Art, Fullstack Dev, orchestrated by a Master agent) for the Aetherbound Online MMORPG. All three call OpenRouter directly — Art looks at existing sprites via a vision-capable free model and decides reuse-vs-generate; the file search itself is plain TypeScript. Generates structured content packages, not code.
